idea-plugin.name: Be Water Converter
idea-plugin.description:
Be water, my friend. Let your data flow between formats.

A visually pleasing data format converter with syntax-highlighted editors, living in a tool window on the right side of your IDE.

Supported formats

  • Bidirectional conversion between JSON, XML, YAML, CSV, TOML and Protobuf
  • Java POJO generation from any supported input, with optional Lombok annotations and ISO-8601 date detection (LocalDate / OffsetDateTime)
  • Kotlin data class generation from any supported input
  • JSON Schema generation (draft 2020-12) from any supported input

Works where you already are

  • Right-click a file or an editor selection to open it in the converter, or convert it straight to another format
  • Results open as scratch files, in a real IDE editor
  • Compare two documents as canonical JSON — the same data in YAML and JSON compares as equal, so only real differences show
  • Subtree filter to convert only the part of a document you care about

Protobuf

  • Full structural parsing of nested message, oneof, and enum blocks
  • Field types that reference known messages are resolved to nested JSON objects
  • JSON-to-Proto generates idiomatic inline nested messages
  • Payload decoding: paste a binary message as hex or base64 and read it as JSON, by field number as protoc --decode_raw does, or by name against its .proto file

CSV & XML

  • Two CSV expansion modes: FLAT_FIRST (safe default) and CROSS_JOIN (full Cartesian product)
  • Comma, semicolon or tab delimiters for reading and writing
  • Configurable row-warning threshold: conversions above it ask before running, in either mode
  • Type inference for CSV and XML input — numbers, booleans and null become typed JSON values

Editor & UI

  • Format-aware pretty-printing, including lenient auto-repair of truncated JSON and tolerant parsing of comments, trailing commas and single quotes
  • Conversion history — restore any of the last 20 conversions from the toolbar
  • Drag-and-drop files onto the input editor with automatic format detection
  • Cancellable background conversions, find bar (Ctrl+F), soft-wrap toggle, one-click swap, copy to clipboard, file import/export
  • Options persist across IDE restarts
